intervals.scope: All 18 commits in v4.0.17..v4.0.19 reviewed, including removed components and Docker/dependency changes. Native library version updates were inspected, but this is not a comprehensive native-package vulnerability audit.

commits.subject: ci: run tests under ASAN and fix use-after-free in DCT hash helper
commits.reason: Adapt the ASAN CI idea to the native ICO/BMP security regressions. Upstream testutil/dct2.c is not present, so its test-only use-after-free fix has no local target. Leak detection remains disabled for unrelated fontconfig allocations.
evidence: Go 1.27.3 full build/vet/Staticcheck, ordinary and race tests, Clang ASAN ICO/BMP tests and govulncheck passed.
Unpatched bmpload.c reproduced an ASAN report: WRITE of size 256, 0 bytes after a 255-byte region (reported as unknown-crash on this toolchain); patched cases passed.

commits.subject: fix: one-byte row buffer overflow on 255-pixel RLE8 absolute runs
commits.reason: Raise the row-buffer minimum from 255 to 256 to include alignment padding for a 255-byte RLE8 absolute run. Preserve the local loader and exercise forced decoding, pixel output, odd/even and truncated input.
evidence: Go 1.27.3 full build/vet/Staticcheck, ordinary and race tests, Clang ASAN ICO/BMP tests and govulncheck passed.
Unpatched bmpload.c reproduced an ASAN report: WRITE of size 256, 0 bytes after a 255-byte region (reported as unknown-crash on this toolchain); patched cases passed.

commits.subject: ContentDisposition fix (#1732)
commits.reason: Remote fetcher/streaming/processing handlers are not imported. Original and transformed local images set no Content-Disposition filename from a URL. The source-offer endpoint uses a fixed ixoss-source.tar.gz filename; unsupported query parameters are rejected.

commits.subject: IMG-210: svg sanitization (#1731)
commits.reason: No SVG sanitizer or xmlparser is imported. Default original SVG requests return 415; transforms reject SVG. Explicit non-image passthrough serves application/octet-stream with nosniff and does not promise SVG sanitization.
